statement.ru: Гелий сначала нашли на Солнце и только потом — на Земле.
statement.en: Helium was found on the Sun first, and only later on Earth.

why: Helium was first seen as an unknown yellow line in sunlight during the 1868 eclipse; it was found on Earth in 1895.

statement.ru: Воздух, которым мы дышим, в основном состоит из кислорода.
statement.en: The air we breathe is mostly oxygen.

why: Dry air is 78% nitrogen and only about 21% oxygen.

statement.ru: Галлий плавится, если подержать его в руке.
statement.en: Gallium melts if you hold it in your hand.

why: Gallium melts at 29.8 °C, below body temperature, so it melts in the hand.

statement.ru: Чистый неон в трубке светится синим.
statement.en: Pure neon in a tube glows blue.

why: Real neon gives a reddish-orange glow; other colours need other gases or coatings.

statement.ru: Когда-то алюминий стоил дороже золота.
statement.en: Aluminium once cost more than gold.

why: In 1852 aluminium sold at $34 an ounce while gold was $19, before cheap smelting was invented.

statement.ru: Элемент уран назван в честь планеты Уран.
statement.en: The element uranium is named after the planet Uranus.

why: Klaproth named it in 1789 after the recently discovered planet Uranus.

statement.ru: Сухой лёд — это замороженная вода.
statement.en: Dry ice is frozen water.

why: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide.

statement.ru: Литий такой лёгкий, что плавает в воде.
statement.en: Lithium is so light that it floats on water.

why: Lithium (0.53 g/cm3) is one of only three metals that float on water.

statement.ru: Углекислый газ легче воздуха.
statement.en: Carbon dioxide is lighter than air.

why: CO2 is about 53% denser than dry air and pools in low places.

statement.ru: Атом почти целиком состоит из пустоты.
statement.en: An atom is almost entirely empty space.

why: The nucleus, which holds nearly all the mass, is tens of thousands of times smaller across than the atom.

statement.ru: Самый плотный металл на свете — свинец.
statement.en: Lead is the densest metal in the world.

why: Osmium is the densest element, about twice as dense as lead; gold too is far denser than lead.

statement.ru: Четыре химических элемента названы в честь одной шведской деревни.
statement.en: Four chemical elements are named after one Swedish village.

why: Yttrium, terbium, erbium and ytterbium are all named after Ytterby.

statement.ru: Возраст костей динозавров узнают радиоуглеродным методом.
statement.en: Dinosaur bones are dated with radiocarbon dating.

why: Radiocarbon reaches back only about 50,000 years; dinosaurs died out 66 million years ago.

statement.ru: Во многих домашних датчиках дыма есть крупинка радиоактивного металла.
statement.en: Many home smoke detectors hold a speck of radioactive metal.

why: Ionization smoke detectors use a tiny amount of americium-241.

statement.ru: Горящий магний можно потушить водой.
statement.en: Burning magnesium can be put out with water.

why: Magnesium is a class D metal fire; water makes such fires worse, dry powder or sand is used.

statement.ru: Полоний назван в честь Польши.
statement.en: Polonium is named after Poland.

why: Marie Skłodowska-Curie named it after her homeland, Poland.

statement.ru: Серебро проводит электричество лучше, чем медь.
statement.en: Silver conducts electricity better than copper.

why: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity of any metal.

statement.ru: «Карат» у золота и «карат» у бриллианта — одна и та же мера.
statement.en: A carat of gold and a carat of a diamond are the same measure.

why: For gems a carat is a mass (0.2 g); for gold it is purity in 24ths.

statement.ru: В XIX веке модные зелёные обои красили краской с мышьяком.
statement.en: In the 19th century, fashionable green wallpaper was coloured with arsenic paint.

why: Scheele's green, an arsenic pigment, was used to colour wallpapers.

statement.ru: Платина названа в честь философа Платона.
statement.en: Platinum is named after the philosopher Plato.

why: The name comes from Spanish platina, 'little silver'.

statement.ru: Фосфор впервые добыли из мочи.
statement.en: Phosphorus was first obtained from urine.

why: Hennig Brand isolated it in 1669 by boiling down and distilling urine.

statement.ru: Металл никель назван в честь американской монеты.
statement.en: The metal nickel is named after the American coin.

why: The other way round: the metal (named from German Kupfernickel, 1751) gave its name to the coin of 1866.

statement.ru: Третий по количеству газ в сухом воздухе — аргон.
statement.en: The third most common gas in dry air is argon.

why: Argon is 0.93% of the atmosphere, after nitrogen and oxygen, far ahead of CO2.

statement.ru: Самый распространённый металл в земной коре — железо.
statement.en: The most common metal in the Earth's crust is iron.

why: Aluminium (about 8%) beats iron (about 5.6%) in the crust.

statement.ru: Железная гиря плавает в ртути.
statement.en: An iron weight floats in mercury.

why: Mercury (13.6 g/cm3) is far denser than iron (7.9 g/cm3), so iron floats on it.

statement.ru: Чистый водород пахнет тухлыми яйцами.
statement.en: Pure hydrogen smells of rotten eggs.

why: Hydrogen gas is colourless and odourless; the rotten-egg smell is hydrogen sulfide.

statement.ru: На сильном морозе оловянные вещи могут рассыпаться в порошок.
statement.en: In hard frost, tin objects can crumble into powder.

why: Tin pest: in the cold, tin turns into a brittle grey form and objects such as buttons decompose into powder.

statement.ru: Газ в кухонной плите пахнет сам по себе, без добавок.
statement.en: Kitchen stove gas has its smell by itself, with nothing added.

why: Natural gas is odourless; a mercaptan odorant is added so leaks can be noticed.

statement.ru: Жидкий кислород притягивается магнитом.
statement.en: Liquid oxygen is attracted by a magnet.

why: Liquid oxygen is paramagnetic and hangs between the poles of a strong magnet.

statement.ru: Хлор — бесцветный газ, как воздух.
statement.en: Chlorine is a colourless gas, like air.

why: Chlorine is a yellow-green gas; its name comes from Greek for pale green.

statement.ru: Название брома по-гречески значит «вонь».
statement.en: The name bromine comes from the Greek for 'stench'.

why: From Greek bromos, 'stench', for its sharp smell.

statement.ru: Учёным уже удавалось превратить другой металл в настоящее золото.
statement.en: Scientists have already turned another metal into real gold.

why: In 1980 Seaborg's team turned thousands of bismuth atoms into gold in a particle accelerator.

statement.ru: Кислород назвали так, потому что думали, что он есть во всех кислотах.
statement.en: Oxygen got its name because people thought all acids contained it.

why: Lavoisier coined oxygène, 'acid-maker', believing oxygen was in every acid.

statement.ru: У аквалангистов в баллонах — чистый кислород.
statement.en: Scuba divers' tanks hold pure oxygen.

why: Recreational scuba tanks usually hold filtered compressed air; pure oxygen is toxic at depth.

statement.ru: Нержавеющей сталь делает добавка хрома.
statement.en: Added chromium is what makes stainless steel stainless.

why: Stainless steel is an iron alloy containing chromium, which makes it resist rust.

statement.ru: Титан тяжелее стали.
statement.en: Titanium is heavier than steel.

why: Titanium (4.5 g/cm3) is as strong as some steels but much less dense (steel about 7.8).

statement.ru: Есть химический элемент, названный в честь Альберта Эйнштейна.
statement.en: There is a chemical element named after Albert Einstein.

why: Einsteinium, element 99, was named after Albert Einstein.

statement.ru: Чистый йод — это коричневая жидкость.
statement.en: Pure iodine is a brown liquid.

why: Iodine is a dark, lustrous solid; the brown liquid in the first-aid kit is iodine dissolved in alcohol.

statement.ru: Название кобальта пошло от кобольда — проказливого горного духа.
statement.en: Cobalt's name comes from the kobold, a mischievous mine spirit.

why: German miners blamed a goblin (kobold) for the troublesome ore, and the name stuck.

statement.ru: Английское слово plumber («сантехник») происходит от латинского названия свинца.
statement.en: The English word plumber comes from the Latin name for lead.

why: From Latin plumbum, lead, as the first effective pipes in Roman times were lead pipes.
